Bug_Title: MF: Method defines a variable that obscures a field (MF_METHOD_MASKS_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
This method defines a local variable with the same name as a field
in this class or a superclass.  This may cause the method to
read an uninitialized value from the field, leave the field uninitialized,
or both.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where a local variable 'value' is defined with the same name as the instance field 'value'. This causes the method to return the local variable's value instead of the instance field's value.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method on an instance of VariableObscuringField initialized with the value 5. The showBug method, due to the bug, returns 10 instead of 5, causing the assertion to fail.
